title: Senior Vice President, Head - Finance,
jobDescription:
Business Function Lead the Finance function for the DBS Tech Centre, ensuring accurate financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and efficient cash flow management. This role manages a team of 11-12, overseeing all aspects of the entity's financial operations. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Include managing HO reporting, Audits – Statutory, Tax & Transfer pricing, Month close activities, Receivables & Treasury operations management, Payables
- vendor & employee, Finance planning & budgeting, Presenting financials in Board & Management meetings, Taxation, etc. Key Accountabilities Provide financial leadership, ensuring adherence to budgets, statutory/regulatory compliance, and effective cash flow management. Oversee all financial reporting to headquarters (HO), monthly closing processes, and statutory audits. Manage the entity's budgeting, forecasting, and management information systems (MIS). Build and develop a scalable finance organization to support future growth. Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing with regional (SGP) and India finance teams. Job Duties & responsibilities Financial Reporting Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate HO reporting, manage internal and external audits, and maintain compliance with all tax regulations and reporting requirements. Experience with transfer pricing and APA is highly desirable. Financial Operations: Oversee transaction processing teams (accounts payable, vendor payments, employee payments), treasury operations, and receivables management. Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and scalability. Financial Planning Analysis: Develop and manage the entity's budget and forecasts. Analyze financial data to provide insights to support business decision-making. Work with LOBT and COO functions to review financials and drive positive business outcomes. Team Management Collaboration: Manage and mentor a team of 11-12 finance professionals. Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and India finance teams. Cost Optimization: Review the cost structure of the lines of business and support functions to identify opportunities for cost optimization at the entity level Required Experience 18-25 years of experience in finance and accounting. Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost Accountant (CMA). Experience with SEZ/STPI entities is preferred. Proven ability in people management and stakeholder management across different geographical locations and functions. Strong communication skills and a willingness to receive and act upon feedback. Proficient in MS Office Suite, Power Point, and accounting ERP systems. Education / Preferred Qualifications Preferably MBA (Finance and/or Accounting) Professional Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) / Cost Accountant (CMA) Core Competencies Dependability — Job requires being reliable, responsible, dependable, and having a firm commitment in fulfilling obligations. Adaptability/Flexibility — Job requires being open to change (positive or negative) and to considerable variety in the workplace. Cooperation — Job requires being pleasant with others on the job and displaying a good-natured, cooperative attitude. Tolerance — Job requires dealing with diverse comments, dealing professionally and effectively handle stress situations. Integrity — Job requires being honest and ethical Empathy — Job requires being sensitive to others' needs and feelings and being understanding and helpful on the job. Leadership — Job requires a willingness to lead, take charge, and offer opinions and direction. Persistence — Job requires persistence & keen eye on ensuring deliverables are met. Analytical Thinking — Job requires analysing information and using logic to address work-related issues and problems. Initiative — Job requires a willingness to take on responsibilities and challenges. Location: Hyderabad

title: Vice President, Enterprise Technology Command Center, Major Incident Manager, DTI Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription:
Business Function Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. Role Purpose: VP, Major Incident Manager for ETCC SRE Operations, is responsible for the end-to-end management of critical and major incidents impacting DBS's technology services. This role focuses on minimizing service disruption, restoring service rapidly, and driving continuous improvement in incident response processes. The Major Incident Manager will lead cross-functional teams during incidents, ensuring clear communication, effective problem resolution, and adherence to SRE principles for reliability and operational excellence. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Major Incident Management: Lead and manage major incidents from detection through resolution, ensuring rapid service restoration and minimal business impact. Act as the primary communication point during major incidents, providing timely and accurate updates to senior management, stakeholders, and affected business units. Own incident escalation to senior management Coordinate and drive technical teams (including SRE, development, infrastructure, and operations) to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production issues. Ensure all incidents are thoroughly documented, including timelines, actions taken, and resolution steps. Ensure compliance with MAS, local in-country regulatory process during incident reporting requirements Facilitate Blameless-incident reviews (BIRs) to identify root causes, preventive measures, and opportunities for process and system improvements. Experience in generating management reports on incidents, problem trends, and thematic analysis. Champion SRE best practices within incident management, focusing on automation, observability, and proactive problem prevention. Collaborate with SRE teams to develop and implement incident response playbooks, runbooks, and automation tools to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Contribute to the definition and monitoring of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) related to incident response and system reliability. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident trends and data to identify systemic issues and areas for improvement in IT systems and processes. Develop and implement strategies to reduce Mean Time To Detect (MTTD), Mean Time To Acknowledge (MTTA), and Mean Time To Restore (MTTR). Drive initiatives to enhance operational resilience, stability, and performance across critical applications and infrastructure. Contribute to the continuous improvement of ETCC incident management policies, procedures, and tools. Stakeholder Management and Communication: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across technology and business units. Effectively manage expectations and provide transparent communication during periods of service disruption. Represent ETCC SRE Operations in various forums and provide updates on incident management performance and initiatives. Team Leadership and Development: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior incident managers and SRE operations staff. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and incident prevention within the team. Required Qualifications & Skills: Experience: Minimum of 10-15 years of experience in IT Operations, Incident Management, or Site Reliability Engineering within a large-scale enterprise environment, preferably in the financial services industry. Demonstrated experience in leading major incidents and coordinating cross-functional technical teams under pressure. Strong understanding of SRE principles and practices. Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of IT infrastructure (servers, storage, networking), cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise applications. Familiarity with incident management tools (e.g., ITSM, Remedy, Service Now, Pager Duty) and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, Elk). Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Shell) is a plus and added advantage. Experience in insurance, banking or regulated financial services environment (mandatory) Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively at all levels. Proven ability to remain calm and decisive during critical incidents, with strong problem-solving capabilities. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Certifications (Good to Have): ITIL V3/V4 Foundation or higher certification. Relevant SRE or Dev Ops certifications. Proficiency in using Gen AI and Microsoft office Location: Hyderabad

title: Associate, Data Analyst, Data Chapter
jobDescription:
Business Function Consumer Banking Group (CBG) enables and empowers the bank through an efficient, agile, and resilient operating model with a strategic focus on productivity, quality, controls, technology, people capabilities, and innovation. Within CBG, we manage critical banking processes and leverage data-driven insights to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and business decision-making across multiple banking channels. Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements for data-driven initiatives. Translate business requirements into analytical requirements, data definitions, reporting specifications, and user stories. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities that support business decision-making. Develop actionable insights and recommendations through data exploration and analysis. Ability to translate business requirements into data and reporting solutions. Excellent communication and presentation skills with both business and technical stakeholders. Strong analytical thinking with attention to detail and data accuracy. Experience working in Agile environments with JIRA. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight timelines. Self-driven, proactive, and collaborative team player with a continuous learning mindset. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline. 3–7 years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Management Information Systems (MIS), Reporting, or Analytics roles. Experience in Consumer Banking, Retail Banking, Operations, Risk, or Financial Services domains. Exposure to data governance, audit, lineage, regulatory reporting, and control frameworks. Familiarity with banking products, operational processes, and customer journey analytics is advantageous. Location: Hyderabad

title: Analyst, Avaloq Developer, Wealth Management Technology
jobDescription:
Business Function Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. Wealth Management Technology As leaders in financial technology, we architect scalable investment and wealth solutions for our mass-affluent clients and offer unparalleled, personalised advice to high-net-worth investors. Our strategic commitment to relentless innovation ensures we actively cultivate a diverse team to transform the financial ecosystem and ensure equitable access to wealth management expertise. As we strategically grow our technological capabilities, we are seeking exceptional Wealth Management experts and Avaloq technologists—trailblazers, change-makers, and future leaders—to drive our next phase of innovation, and we believe your network might include such transformative talent. Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are seeking an experienced Avaloq Parameterization Specialist to join our Wealth Management platform. This pivotal role involves strengthening our core systems by leveraging your strong technical expertise in software development and solution design, specifically within the Avaloq Banking Suite. You will be instrumental in translating complex business requirements into efficient Avaloq solutions, contributing directly to the enhancement of our wealth management offerings. Solution Design & Implementation: Comprehend intricate user requirements and translate them into robust and scalable solutions utilizing Avaloq parameterization, complemented by effective Unix and shell scripting. Development & Quality Assurance: Design, develop, and meticulously test solutions, adhering to the highest quality standards and best practices to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Technical Validation & Alignment: Collaborate closely with Architects, Business Stakeholders, and technical teams to validate proposed solutions, ensuring they are not only technically sound but also optimally aligned with customer expectations and strategic objectives. Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a go-to subject matter expert for assigned Avaloq modules, confidently delivering complex solutions independently and providing guidance to junior team members. Independent Contribution & Prioritization: Work autonomously in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, effectively managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality results within established timelines. Impactful Contribution: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our online banking and online investment applications by developing features that enhance user experience, streamline operations, and meet evolving business needs. Requirements Experience in Avaloq Parameterization: Demonstrated hands-on experience in Avaloq parameterization, with a proven track record of successfully implementing and configuring Avaloq modules. Avaloq Development Expertise: 1-8 years of dedicated Avaloq Development experience, including the ability to independently develop software changes and conduct thorough unit testing. Unix & Shell Scripting Proficiency: Good hands-on experience with Unix shell scripting for automation, system administration, and data manipulation within an Avaloq environment. Avaloq Certified Professional (ACP): While not mandatory, an Avaloq Certified Professional (ACP) certification is highly preferred and will be a significant advantage. Wealth Management Domain Knowledge: Understanding of Wealth Management concepts, products, and processes, enabling you to better contextualize and optimize Avaloq solutions for our business needs. Agile Methodologies Experience: Practical experience working within Agile development methodologies, promoting iterative development, collaboration, and continuous delivery. Problem-Solving & Attention to Detail: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring the delivery of high-quality and error-free solutions. Database Skills: Knowledge of Oracle databases and proficiency in PL/SQL for data querying, manipulation, and optimization. Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and clients in a clear and concise manner. Language Proficiency: Very good command of English, both written and verbal, for effective technical documentation and stakeholder communication. Avaloq Banking Software: Minimum of 2
- 8 years of hands-on experience with the Avaloq banking software, demonstrating practical application of its functionalities. Overall Software Development: A minimum of 2+ years of overall experience in software development, showcasing a strong foundation in programming principles and practices. Educational Background: A University degree or equivalent in engineering, preferably in computer science or a related technical field. General Programming Acumen: Proven general software programming experience, indicating adaptability and a strong grasp of various programming paradigms. Location: Hyderabad

- Educational Background: A University degree or equivalent in engineering, preferably in computer science or a related technical field.
